name: Oohara Hinako
source:
The protagonist of this work. A cheerful girl with a custard pudding hair.
She was a high school student, but school was closed due to the approaching giant meteorite.
Figuring she might as well, she decided to go on a journey.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4069400/Chill_Planet/]Steam[/url]]
